gloss: step by step; one step at a time

definitions.gloss: step by step; one step at a time; gradually
definitions.explanation: Moving forward or making progress gradually, taking one step at a time.

examples.japanese: {一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ}⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ}⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying Japanese one step at a time.

examples.japanese: {一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ}⟦{着実|ちゃくじつ}→着実：07989_chakujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
examples.english: I'm steadily getting closer to my goal, step by step.

notes:
{一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ} emphasizes deliberate, steady progress — taking things one step at a time without rushing. It carries a positive, encouraging tone.

FORMS:
Reduplication of ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧ (one step). This X+X pattern emphasizes repetition and steadiness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ}⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to advance step by step
- {一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ}⟦{着実|ちゃくじつ}→着実：07989_chakujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: steadily, step by step
- {一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ}⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grow step by step

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: little by little (more neutral, less deliberate)
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually (more formal, emphasizes slow change)
- ⟦{着実|ちゃくじつ}→着実：07989_chakujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: steadily (emphasizes reliability)
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: one step at a time (similar meaning, slightly less literary)
